title: Exam Analysis
subtitle: AI-assisted reading of medical exams. Findings are preliminary and require clinical validation.

toast.uploadError: Failed to submit exam for analysis.

uploader.errorLimit: "{{fileName}}" is {{size}}, above the {{maxSize}} MB limit. Choose a smaller file.
uploader.errorType: "{{fileName}}" is not a supported format. Choose a PNG, JPG or PDF file.
uploader.title: Submit Exam for Analysis
uploader.subtitle: Drag radiological exam files, clinical photos or laboratory PDFs. The analysis is assistive and probabilistic.
uploader.fileGuidelines: Accepted formats: PNG, JPG or PDF. Up to {{maxSize}} MB, one file at a time.
uploader.consentDesc: I confirm that I have the patient's express authorization to submit their data and images for assistive clinical processing.
uploader.anonymizeDesc: Removes the file metadata and the original file name before the exam is sent for analysis.
uploader.errorEmpty: "{{fileName}}" is empty (0 bytes). Choose a different file.
uploader.dropActive: Drop the file to select it
uploader.consentIfUnchecked: Without this confirmation the exam cannot be sent.
uploader.stillNeeded: To send, you still need to:
uploader.successNextStep: We will notify you when the result is ready. You can follow the progress in the analysis history.
uploader.failedTitle: The exam could not be sent.
uploader.failedHelp: Your file and options were kept. Check your connection and try sending again.
uploader.cancelledHelp: Nothing was sent. Your file and options were kept, so you can try again.
uploader.anonymizeLimitation: Text printed inside the image is NOT removed. Avoid images where names or ID numbers are visible.
uploader.externalProcessingTitle: The exam will be sent with identifying data
uploader.externalProcessingWarning: The original file, including any identifying data such as the patient name, ID numbers, file metadata and file name, will be processed by an external AI service.
uploader.acknowledgementTitle: I understand the exam will be processed without anonymization
uploader.missingAcknowledgement: Confirm that you understand the exam will be processed without anonymization (step 2).

serverError.contentMismatchTitle: The file content does not match its extension.
serverError.contentMismatchHelp: The file looks like a different type than its name says. Your file was kept: pick the correct exam file with Replace file, then send again.
serverError.corruptedTitle: The file appears to be corrupted.
serverError.corruptedHelp: We could not read this file. Your file was kept: pick another copy of the exam with Replace file, then send again.
serverError.emptyTitle: The server received an empty file.
serverError.emptyHelp: The file has no content. Your file was kept: pick the correct exam file with Replace file, then send again.
serverError.deidentificationTitle: Sending without anonymization needs your confirmation.
serverError.deidentificationHelp: Keep anonymization checked, or confirm that you understand the exam will be processed without it, then send again.

card.noExamDesc: Select an exam from the history beside this panel or upload a new exam to view preliminary findings.
card.processingDesc: The artificial intelligence is extracting findings and assessing image quality. This usually takes a few moments.
card.failedDesc: Could not process the exam image. Check if the format is valid and try again.
card.cause2: Excessively cropped image or inappropriate framing.
card.cause3: Illegible image or severe motion blur.
card.cause4: Multiple exams or documents mixed in the same file.
card.urgencyCaption: Urgency classification from the assistive analysis. Confirm before acting.
card.findingsCaption: The action level combines how significant the finding is with how confident the model is.
card.noFindings: No findings were identified in this image.
